# AKSHAY KUMAR

## PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
STEM MBA candidate at American University Kogod School of Business (May 2027, GPA 3.17/4.0) and computer science engineer with 7+ years of experience delivering enterprise analytics, automated data pipelines, and operational decision-support systems. Built mission-critical workflow and demand-forecasting platforms for the U.S. Department of State (commended by the U.S. Ambassador) and engineered high-throughput verification pipelines screening 97M+ records for Capital One loan operations.

---

## CORE COMPETENCIES & TECHNICAL SKILLS
- **Programming & Data Engineering:** Python, Java, SQL (PostgreSQL, MySQL), R, C/C++, DuckDB, Pandas, NumPy, RESTful APIs, ETL/ELT Pipelines
- **Analytics, BI & Modeling:** Power BI, Microsoft Excel (Advanced/VBA), statsmodels, Time-Series Forecasting (Holt-Winters), Anomaly Detection (CUSUM, Z-score, IQR), Metric Validation (MAE, RMSE, MAPE)
- **Enterprise & Cloud Infrastructure:** Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, SharePoint), AWS (S3), Docker, Git, GitHub Actions CI/CD, Linux/Windows Systems
- **Frontend & Visual Analytics:** Three.js, WebGL, Globe.gl, D3.js (TopoJSON), Plotly.js, Chart.js, React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS

---

## PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

### U.S. Department of State · Consular Affairs
**Business Analyst** | November 2022 – September 2025 | New Delhi, India
- Received formal commendation from the U.S. Ambassador for technical engineering and deployment of consular operational systems across diplomatic posts in India.
- Built seasonal demand and capacity forecasting dashboards in Power BI and Excel, enabling data-driven consular officer allocation and increasing daily visa adjudication throughput by 30%.
- Replaced fragmented manual intake workflows by designing centralized Power Apps and Power Automate systems with SharePoint backend, consolidating consular inquiries and reducing triage response latency by 65%.
- Automated American Citizen Services (ACS) case tracking and statutory reporting pipelines, reducing biweekly leadership review cycles by 24% while eliminating cross-departmental data reconciliation discrepancies.
- Directed technical inventory auditing and lifecycle migration for $500K+ in diplomatic IT infrastructure across four consular posts, achieving 99.4% tracking accuracy against federal property registries.
- Coordinated multi-post deployment and user onboarding for biometric and consular vetting systems, training 40+ staff members on daily operational compliance and intake protocols.

### AIS Info (Capital One Delivery)
**Software Engineer** | November 2021 – November 2022 | Gurugram, India
- Engineered automated Java batch ETL pipelines ingesting and indexing 12M federal bankruptcy court filings across 94 U.S. districts, achieving 99.6% classification accuracy and sub-second fraud query retrieval for Capital One underwriting.
- Built distributed ingestion jobs processing 85M+ deceased-person public records into high-throughput verification databases, screening $350M+ in consumer and commercial loan applications with zero data discrepancies.
- Refactored legacy batch verification services into high-performance RESTful API endpoints, reducing applicant identity verification latency by 40% and saving loan analysts 30+ manual audit hours weekly.
- Implemented automated database consistency checks, duplicate record isolation, and dead-letter queue monitoring across multi-source financial feeds to enforce strict banking data governance SLAs.

### MS Star Computers
**Software Application Developer** | July 2018 – November 2021 | New Delhi, India
- Managed systems administration, security patching, and network routing for 350+ commercial workstations and server clusters across 8 regional centers, sustaining 99.8% operational uptime.
- Developed and deployed a cross-platform Flutter educational portal for three K-12 partner schools during emergency remote-learning mandates, securing 98% student adoption and supporting 2,000+ daily active concurrent sessions.
- Built automated administrative reporting scripts using Python and VBA to parse student performance and billing logs, eliminating manual record entry and saving 15+ staff administrative hours weekly.

---

## FLAGSHIP TECHNICAL PROJECTS

### Deborah Autonomous Deep-Research Engine (v3.5)
*Production Enterprise System | Python, Flask, ReportLab, openpyxl, IRS EO BMF, ProPublica API* | [github.com/akbknight/deborah-research-engine](https://github.com/akbknight/deborah-research-engine)
- Engineered an autonomous organization intelligence and deep-research engine that resolves corporate and nonprofit identities, discovers public disclosures, and extracts multi-year audited financial statements without paid APIs or external LLMs.
- Implemented resilient offline/anonymous retrieval adapters across public IRS Business Master Files and ProPublica datasets, parsing Schedule A/B/I grant flows and balance sheets into PDF, Excel, HTML, and JSON packages.
- Built single-use cryptographic token loopback authentication with strict same-origin enforcement and bounded egress throttling to guarantee secure local enterprise execution.

### IRS 990 Philanthropic Spatial Miner & 3D Intelligence Engine
*Interactive 3D WebGL Platform | Python, Globe.gl, Three.js, Plotly.js, D3 TopoJSON, DuckDB* | [akbknight.github.io/irs990-grant-dashboard](https://akbknight.github.io/irs990-grant-dashboard/)
- Built an end-to-end analytics engine mapping $550.2B in charitable capital flows across 9.7M+ IRS Form 990 tax records with sub-second client-side query execution powered by DuckDB.
- Rendered hardware-accelerated 3D WebGL global capital flow arcs, interactive econometric log-log outlier detection matrices, and national county-level TopoJSON choropleth maps.

### U.S. Retail Sales Demand Forecast Engine
*Econometric Time-Series System | Python, statsmodels, Pandas, FRED API, Three.js, Chart.js* | [akbknight.github.io/us-retail-sales-forecast](https://akbknight.github.io/us-retail-sales-forecast/)
- Modeled 18-month predictive demand for U.S. Retail & Food Services using Holt-Winters triple exponential smoothing on 10+ years of Federal Reserve Economic Data (FRED).
- Evaluated model accuracy across rolling validation windows, securing 3.4% holdout MAPE with 80% and 95% confidence intervals and an interactive hyperparameter tuning interface.

### Diplomatic Resource & Scheduling Optimizer
*Constrained Optimization Engine | JavaScript, Greedy CSP Algorithm, Three.js, Chart.js* | [akbknight.github.io/scheduling-optimizer](https://akbknight.github.io/scheduling-optimizer/)
- Developed a greedy constraint-satisfaction scheduling system resolving high-density diplomatic logistics: 180 priority meeting requests across 20 secure conference rooms and 150 cleared personnel.
- Modeled conflict-detection logic with sub-millisecond execution, stress-test simulation parameters, and a dynamic 3D kinetic lattice visualization.

---

## EDUCATION

### American University, Kogod School of Business
**Master of Business Administration (MBA) — STEM-Designated** | Expected May 2027 | Washington, DC
- **Concentration:** Business Analytics & Artificial Intelligence | **GPA:** 3.17 / 4.0
- **Leadership:** Operations Leader, Analytics Club at American University
- **Selected Coursework:** Predictive Analytics, Database & Big Data, AI for Business Strategy, Managerial Statistics

### Maharishi Dayanand University
**Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech) in Computer Science & Engineering** | Graduated August 2021 | Rohtak, India
- **Academic Standing:** First Class with Distinction
